channel.title: Rally Point News — Rally Briefs
channel.description: Source-based explainers and original Rally Briefs from Rally Point News.

item.title: What Are the New Crypto Ethics Rules in the CLARITY Act?
item.description: The revised CLARITY Act adds proposed conflict-of-interest rules for federal officials, judges and spouses, including new enforcement authority and requirements for some significant crypto-related interests.

item.title: Why Do the Hanish Islands Matter for Red Sea Shipping?
item.description: Houthi forces seized Greater and Lesser Hanish, strengthening their position near Bab el-Mandeb while commercial shipping through the chokepoint continues.

item.title: What Does “Slowing AI Development” Actually Mean?
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei proposed pacing frontier AI development rather than halting it, with outside evaluators, safety checkpoints and broader coordination; OpenAI CEO Sam Altman publicly agreed with the need to pace the frontier.

item.title: Why Did Oil Prices Jump Nearly 3% After the Saudi Pipeline Shutdown?
item.description: Oil prices rose about 3% after attacks led Saudi Arabia to shut its East-West pipeline as risks also increased around major regional shipping routes.

item.title: Why Did Amazon Suspend 21 Air After the Miami Cargo Plane Crash?
item.description: Amazon paused operations with 21 Air after Flight 7598 overran a Miami runway and killed five people; the NTSB has not yet determined a probable cause.

item.title: Can Trump’s New USPS Mail-Ballot Rules Take Effect for the 2026 Midterms?
item.description: Two federal judges have blocked new USPS mail-ballot requirements for the 2026 midterms while the Supreme Court considers an emergency appeal.

item.title: What Did the Judge Rule About FEMA’s 50% Staffing Cut?
item.description: A federal judge ruled that DHS acted unlawfully in directing FEMA toward a 50% workforce cut; the remedy and final staffing consequences remain unresolved.

item.title: Charlie Kirk Memorial Statue Vandalized in Phoenix
item.description: A memorial statue of Charlie Kirk outside Turning Point USA's Phoenix headquarters was defaced with red paint; police are investigating and no suspect has been identified.

item.title: Trump Says U.S. Will Lift 10% Tariff on Irish Whiskey
item.description: President Donald Trump says the United States will remove its 10% tariff on Irish whiskey, though implementation details and timing remain unclear.

item.title: Tom Tiffany Plane Makes Emergency Landing in Lake Wausau
item.description: Rep. Tom Tiffany and a pilot escaped with minor injuries after a small plane lost power and made an emergency water landing in Lake Wausau, Wisconsin.

item.title: What the Hurricane Forecast Cone Really Means
item.description: A source-based explainer of the National Hurricane Center forecast cone, model guidance, forecast uncertainty, and why impacts can occur outside the cone.
